tree.name: README.md
tree.content:
# mdlite A small Python library that converts Markdown to HTML. Handles headings, paragraphs, bold, italic, inline code, links, and flat lists. ## Requirements - Python 3.10 or higher - pytest (for running tests) ## Installation ```bash git clone https://github.com/riya-dev/mdlite.git cd mdlite pip install -r requirements.txt ``` ## Usage ```python form src.mdlite import render html = render("# Hello\n\nThis is **bold** and *italic*.") print(html) #

Hello

#

This is bold and italic.

``` ## Running tests ```bash pytest tests/ ``` All tests must pass before you open a pull request. See CONTRIBUTING.md. ## Supported syntax | Syntax | Output | |---|---| | `# Heading` | `

` | | `**bold**` or `__bold__` | `` | | `*italic*` | `` | | `` `code` `` | `` | | `[text](url)` | `` | | `- item` | `
  • ` | ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request. ## License MIT

tree.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
tree.content:
# Contributing to mdlite

Thanks for your interest in contributing.

## Before you start

Check the open issues. If you want to work on one, leave a comment first and wait for a reply. This avoids two people working on the same thing.

If you find a new bug, open an issue before submitting a PR.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install black
```

## Branch naming

Use `<type>/<short-desc>`, for example:

- `fix/trailing-spaces`
- `test/empty-input`
- `docs/readme-typo`

## Rules

1. Every change needs a test. Bug fixes need a test that fails before and passes after.
2. Run `black src/ tests/` before pushing. CI checks formatting.
3. One issue per PR. Do not bundle fixes.
4. Link the issue your PR fixes with `Fixes #<number>` in the description.

children.name: ci.yml
children.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: black --check src/ tests/
      - run: pytest tests/
